# Prime Maths Tutoring

> One-to-one online maths tutoring for students in the UK at KS3, GCSE and A-level, including Further Maths. Every tutor got a grade 9 at GCSE and an A* at A-level in the subjects they teach, and sat those exams within the last few years.

## Key facts

- Lessons: one-to-one, online over Zoom, on evenings and weekends
- Levels: KS3 Maths (Years 7 to 9), GCSE Maths and Further Maths (Foundation and Higher), A-level Maths and Further Maths
- Exam boards: AQA, Edexcel and OCR
- Prices: £25 an hour for KS3 and GCSE, £30 an hour for A-level Maths, £35 an hour for A-level Further Maths. No long-term contract
- First session: a free 20 to 30 minute introductory video call, with no obligation
- Science tutoring is also available on request
- Results: GCSE students typically improve by 3 or more grades, and every family that has started with us has stayed
- Founder: Harmaan, Founder and Head Tutor, who is studying Mathematics at a top UK university
- Contact: hello@primemathstutoring.co.uk

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.primemathstutoring.co.uk/): what we offer, how it works, prices, feedback from families and FAQs
- [Book a free intro](https://www.primemathstutoring.co.uk/book): booking form for the free introductory session
- [Contact](https://www.primemathstutoring.co.uk/contact): questions about prices, lessons, levels, science tutoring or becoming a tutor
- [Guides](https://www.primemathstutoring.co.uk/guides): free guides to how the exams work and how to prepare, written by our tutors
  - [GCSE Maths](https://www.primemathstutoring.co.uk/guides/gcse-maths): AQA, Edexcel and OCR papers, tiers, the formulae sheet and a revision plan
  - [GCSE Further Maths](https://www.primemathstutoring.co.uk/guides/gcse-further-maths): the AQA Level 2 Further Maths certificate and OCR Additional Maths
  - [A-level Maths](https://www.primemathstutoring.co.uk/guides/a-level-maths): paper structure on every board, the large data set and a two-year plan
  - [A-level Further Maths](https://www.primemathstutoring.co.uk/guides/a-level-further-maths): core pure, options on each board and how to prepare
